routes.label: Express how the statement can fail

question: Which of the following is the negation of the statement: For all \(x\) of a certain set, \(x^2\gt0?\)
solution:
The claim that every member of a set satisfies a condition fails exactly when at least one member does not satisfy it. Thus “for all” changes to “for some,” with the same set understood.

The failure of \(x^2>0\) is \(x^2\leq0\), including equality. Therefore the negation is: “For some \(x\) in the given set, \(x^2\leq0\).” The answer is choice E.
